title: General Veronhar
summary: General Veronhar orders lethal arrow volleys while his commanders assist.
overview: General Veronhar orders lethal arrow volleys while his commanders assist.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: When the general orders the archers to ready their bows, duck before the five-second warning ends.
Keep supporting commanders controlled while maintaining the boss tank.
Fight inside the encounter area; pulling the enemies beyond its limits causes a return and cleansing response.
